articleTitle: Impact of Electric Vehicles Access to Distribution Network under V2G Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Established the electric vehicles charging load demand model and the electric vehicles response discharge model under vehicle-to-grid (V2G) mode. The IEEE33-bus distribution system is selected for simulation, and Monte Carlo simulation is used to simulate the impact of electric vehicles charging and discharging on distribution network loss and node voltage. The results indicate that reasonable charging and discharging of electric vehicles under V2G mode can effectively improve the impact of electric vehicles access to distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of Multi-HVDC power coordinated control strategy on frequency stability in multi partitioned power grid
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With expanding of power grid and increasing of load, the synchronous power grid in load intensive areas faces many risks that are hard to solve, and the asynchronous partitioned grid will be the development trend in the future. Aiming at the problem of frequency stability of partitioned power grid, this paper proposes a research method of multi HVDC power frequency coordination control strategy between partitioned power grids. Firstly, based on the key index of frequency stability, the influence mechanism of HVDC FLC function on the frequency response characteristics of power grid is discussed. Then, according to the guide on security and stability for power systems, the first level standard of the guide is appropriately considered, and the test evaluation method of coordinated control strategy is studied, then the test scheme design guide is formulated. Last, taking a three-partitioned-grids-seven-HVDC-interconnected-system as an example, based on the large power grid real-time simulation test platform, the single HVDC blocking fault tests are carried out in the form of hardware in the loop simulation tests with different coordinated control schemes. The research results show that the frequency stability of partitioned power grid can be effectively improved by designing multi-HVDC power coordinated control scheme, formulating reasonable control parameters and carrying out real-time simulation test of large power grid.

articleTitle: DC Transformation Scheme for Low-Voltage Management in AC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The incompatibility between the construction of distribution network and the level of load development is the prime cause for the low-voltage problem at user side. The low-voltage problem at the end of AC distribution network will affect the normal power consumption. Traditional low-voltage managements are not efficient. Therefore, this paper proposes a DC transformation scheme based on flexible DC technology. Through a set of back-to-back AC/DC converters connected in series to AC transmission line, voltage control at user side is realized. The proposed scheme has the advantages of short reconstruction cycle, high cost-effectiveness. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed scheme is verified by an engineering application.

articleTitle: Parameter Identification and Optimization of PI Controllers for Islanded DC Micro-grids
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: DC bus voltage is an important indicator for the safe and stable operation of DC micro-grids. In response to the DC bus voltage fluctuations (DC BVF) caused by the cascading of photovoltaic systems, this paper proposes a PI parameter optimization algorithm to improve the bus voltage stability. An islanded DC micro-grid model is constructed in Simulink, the initial PI parameter values are set according to the empirical method, and then more parameters are sampled isometrically, and the parameter optimization algorithm is designed to find the parameters that make the bus voltage more stable. Simulation results show that the parameters derived from PI optimization improve the bus voltage significantly compared to other parameters brought into the controller. The design of PI optimization algorithm has wide versatility compared to the traditional PI control, saves the time of parameter tuning, avoids the error of observation, and finally makes the micro-grid bus voltage more stable.

articleTitle: Low-carbon Economic Scheduling of Park Integrated Energy System Considering User-side Shared Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Energy storage plays a pivotal role as a flexible resource in the energy system and constitutes an essential component of integrated energy systems. However, the current state of energy storage faces challenges such as exorbitant investment costs and suboptimal utilization rates. Shared energy storage introduces a novel approach to foster scalable development of energy storage. Shared energy storage is introduced on the user side, and a low-carbon economic dispatch model of the park integrated energy system considering shared energy storage is established. Firstly, user-side shared energy storage is introduced, and a framework for the integrated energy system of the park based on shared energy storage is constructed. Then, considering factors such as electricity and gas procurement costs, wind and photovoltaic curtailment costs, investment and construction expenses, shared services, and carbon emissions, a low-carbon economic dispatch model of the park integrated energy system based on user-side shared energy storage is established. Lastly, taking an industrial park in the northern region as an example, four typical application scenarios are set up: no storage configuration, user-self-built independent energy storage, shared power energy storage and shared electricity-heat energy storage. A comparative analysis evaluates each scenario’s low-carbon economic dispatch situation. The results show that shared energy storage has significant low-carbon economic benefits and engineering application value.

articleTitle: Joint low-carbon economic dispatch of power system considering reward-penalty ladder carbon trading and demand response
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Using carbon trading and demand response to achieve reasonable and adequate joint dispatch of the power system is very effective in promoting the power industry to complete the purpose of a low carbon economy. Therefore, by analyzing and calculating reward-penalty ladder carbon transaction costs and demand response, a low-carbon economy joint dispatching model of a power system is established, which considering reward-penalty ladder carbon trading and demand response. The model synthetically consider various constraints such as system network security, demand response, carbon emissions and adapts to piecewise linearization to solve the model. The example shows the carbon trading model enables up to a 9.4% reduction of emissions of the system. Combined with demand response, the system’s total operating cost can be reduced by 6.7%. Operating costs and carbon emissions are reduced by the model, resulting in low-carbon economic power generation.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of interior design temperature on energy consumption and carbon emission of large space buildings in cold regions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Reducing building energy consumption is the fundamental way to reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions. In order to explore the energy saving and emission reduction potential of typical large space buildings in cold regions due to the change of interior design temperature, and to explore the energy saving and emission reduction of building air conditioning heating and the proportion of energy saving and emission reduction, this study selected a large space gymnasium of a university in Gansu Province as the benchmark building, and established 81 building energy consumption calculation models in Designbuilder. The cold and heat load, air conditioning load, carbon emission and uncomfortable hours of the building under different interior design temperatures were simulated and calculated. Based on the data of energy consumption and carbon emission of air conditioning and heating in buildings, the changes and change rules of energy consumption, carbon emission, energy saving, emission reduction, energy saving and emission reduction ratio and comfort hours under different temperature setting values are analyzed. It provides the basis and data support for the multiobjective optimization of energy consumption, carbon emission and comfort time of large space buildings based on interior design temperature in cold regions in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Battery Body Modeling of Electrochemical Energy Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the development of large-scale energy storage technology, electrochemical energy storage technology has been widely used as one of the main methods, among which electrochemical energy storage power station is one of its important applications. Through the modeling research of electrochemical energy storage power station, it is found that the current modeling research of electrochemical energy storage power station does not does not give enough consideration to the the characteristics of the energy storage battery, which can not meet the simulation analysis requirements of the current electrochemical energy storage power station. Therefore, this paper takes the energy storage battery body in the electrochemical energy storage power station as the research object, and establishes an electrochemical energy storage battery model considering the characteristics of various batteries at different ambient temperatures. Firstly, the working principle and basic characteristics of the selected energy storage battery are analyzed, and then the equivalent circuit model of the energy storage battery is established. Based on this model, a battery equivalent model considering the basic characteristics of battery capacity, battery voltage and battery internal resistance at different temperatures is established. Finally, through modeling and simulation analysis, and compared with the measured data, it is proved that the model can accurately describe the working characteristics of the energy storage battery in the electrochemical energy storage power station, and can be applied to the current electrochemical energy storage power station modeling research.

articleTitle: Low equivalent capacity 12 pulse rectifier diode open circuit fault location study
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In order to further improve the reliability and safety of the rectifier system and ensure the stable operation of the rectifier. A characteristic parameter for locating the fault site is obtained through the study of the open-circuit fault of a zigzag autotransformer 12-vehicle wave rectifier having a low equivalent capacity. Firstly, the current-voltage characteristics based on the zigzag autotransformer 12 pulse-wave rectifier in normal operating condition are presented. Secondly, the number of open-circuit diode faults in the 12-pulse rectifier is classified and studied, and the harmonic content, voltage and current characteristics under different fault conditions are discussed. Finally, the load voltage is determined as a fault characteristic parameter to carry out fault early warning, and the fault can be found and the fault element can be located by monitoring the minimum occurrence time of the load voltage, so as to take corresponding predictive maintenance.

articleTitle: Sizing and Energy Management Method of Energy Storage System in Urban Rail Transit
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The energy storage system (ESS) can efficiently reduce the energy cost and achieve substation peak shaving in urban rail transit (URT), due to its characteristics of high-power density. However, the balance between economy operation and system operation stability is hard to achieve in the practical project. This paper proposed an optimization method of sizing and energy management of ESS in URT. The mathematic model of system has been established first, including URT model and ESS model. Then, a power flow analysis method of DC traction system with ESS has been introduced. Based on this power flow method, a bi-level optimization of sizing and energy management is proposed for the ESS in the URT, considering system daily operation cost and substation peak power. The case study based on Merseyrail line verifies that the proposed method can efficiently reduce the system operation cost by 23.19% and substation peak power by 63.54%.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategy: Microgrid Integrated with Hybrid PV-T, EV, and Battery
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: This study presents an analysis of a microgrid with the integration of photovoltaic glass (PV-glass), hybrid thermal photovoltaic (HPV-T), and a battery as a storage system. Also, as a novel energy management strategy, PV-glass (car body PV) is used to maintain the state of charge (SOC) of an EV’s battery; on the other hand, in this paper, V2G is used as an energy management strategy. This topology covers the demand of the house on the longest day of the year, in summer, with the assumption that the battery bank is initially discharged. Furthermore, genetic algorithms (GA) and particle swarm optimization (PSO) are used to calculate the optimal cost of HPV-T and PV-glass. So, the optimal sizes of HPV-T and PV-glass are $10\mathrm{m}^{2}$ and $7.3\mathrm{m}^{2}$, respectively.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Strategy of Microgrid with Electric Vehicles Based on Demand Response Guidance
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Under the guidance of the concept of low-carbon travel, aiming at the challenges brought by the large-scale grid connection of electric vehicles to the safe and reliable operation of the microgrid system, this paper proposes a microgrid optimization scheduling strategy considering the access of electric vehicles. Firstly, the road network with complex road conditions is normalized, and the optimal scheme of electric vehicles scheduling route is formulated based on Floyd algorithm. Then, considering the active network loss and node voltage deviation of microgrid, an optimal scheduling model of microgrid considering unit operation constraints is established. Finally, based on the extended IEEE33-bus test system, the simulation analysis is carried out to verify the impact of network reconfiguration and flexible load participation in demand response on the optimal scheduling of microgrid. The simulation results show that this method is beneficial to improve the voltage quality of microgrid, reduce the peak-valley difference of load curve and improve the system operation profit.

articleTitle: Effects of Hillside Slopes on the Flow Field of Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The flow field of wind farms built on complex surfaces is influenced by the terrain. Site selection of wind farm requires fully understanding of the impact of terrain on the flow field and power output of wind farms. Wind farms over hillsides of various slopes are simulated based on the actuator disk model. Impact of the slope and installation position of wind turbines on the velocity deficit are studied. The slope of hillside shows significant impact on the flow field of wind farm, and plays an important role in the rational choice and layout of wind turbines.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Steel Grounding Grid Considering Service Life Corrosion
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Some grounding grids made of steel are corroded by soil, the cross-sectional area of grounding conductor decreases with the increase of service life. Therefore, there may be grounding corrosion risk. In order to consider the influence of service life corrosion, a performance evaluation method of corroded steel grounding grids has been proposed. Firstly, the eight-index method has been used to evaluate the average annual corrosion rate of soil. Secondly, the accelerated corrosion effect of AC stray current on operating grounding grids has been analyzed. Finally, the residual cross-sectional area of grounding conductor has been solved according to service life, and its grounding impedance, conducting resistance, and current-carrying capacity have been checked. This paper provides an engineering means for the performance evaluation of corroded grounding grids, which can accurately analyze the remaining life of grounding grids.

articleTitle: Research and Verification of Local Thermal Fault Simulation Test Platform in Power Transformer Oil
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The analysis of dissolved gas in oil is very important to ensure the safe operation of power transformer. At present, the analysis methods based on dissolved gas in oil still need a lot of fault simulation data to improve and further improve the fault diagnosis rate. Aiming at the simulation requirements of local overheating fault in oil, this paper carried out functional analysis of local overheating fault simulation test platform in power transformer oil, designed four main modules, electrical circuit, temperature control circuit, circulation circuit and simulation tank system, built a physical test platform for local overheating fault in power transformer oil, and carried out heating performance and gas production verification tests of the test platform. The heating test shows that the test platform in this paper can reach a local overheating of $300^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ within 20min. The local overheating test shows that the test platform can effectively produce dissolved gas in oil, and the gas type and content are consistent with the analysis results of the three-ratio method, which verifies that the test platform can effectively simulate the local overheating fault.

Author Keywords: Analysis of dissolved gases in oil

articleTitle: Multi-wind Farm Output Scenario Generation Method Based on Copula Function
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In the case of large-scale wind power connected to the power system, because wind power is unstable, uncontrollable, and random, it is important to obtain their change laws and generate scenarios. Aiming at the difficulty of generating scenarios for multiple wind farms and the poor effect of scenario generation, this paper proposes a scenario generation method based on copula function and kernel density estimation method. This method can take into account both time correlation and spatial correlation for better power system scheduling and planning. In order to verify the accuracy and effectiveness of this method, this paper takes the output of actual wind farms in a region of a certain province, China as a sample, and generates a large number of spatially and temporally correlated wind power output scenarios. These generated scenarios better reflect the correlation between the output of multiple wind farms. This paper also validates the superiority of the proposed method by using several assessment methods.

articleTitle: Research on Terahertz Detection Method for Layered Defects in Vehicle Cable Terminals Based on FDTD
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Composite vehicle cable terminals are important components of the traction power supply system for multiple-unit trains, and they often exhibit defects such as insulation delamination during service. For the detection of layered defects in vehicle cable terminals, terahertz non-destructive testing has the advantages of safety, effectiveness, non-destructiveness, and comprehensiveness, making it highly innovative and superior compared to other testing methods. Firstly, a simplified model of the actual vehicle cable terminal was constructed, consisting of a stress tube, ethylene propylene rubber(EPR) insulation, and copper core. Numerical analysis of the prefabricated layered defect terminal model was then conducted using the time-domain finite difference method. In the modeling process, the refractive indices of the stress tube and ethylene propylene rubber insulation in the terahertz band were extracted using a transmission-type terahertz system and imported into the three-dimensional model of the time-domain finite difference system for numerical analysis. Defect information was quantitatively analyzed through the analysis of flight time. Finally, the simulation results were compared and analyzed with the predetermined parameters, and the consistency between the simulation results and the predetermined parameters indicated that the finite-difference time domain (FDTD)method can be successfully applied to non-destructive testing of the simulation of layered defects in vehicle cable terminals.

Author Keywords: Vehicle cable terminal Non-destructive testing FDTD

articleTitle: Study on the failure prediction method of urban building materials based on the wavelength variation rule of rare earth ions*
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the continuous development of smart cities, the failure prediction of urban building structure materials has also become an unignorable part of smart city construction. In this study, $\mathrm{Eu}^{3+}$ was selected as the luminescent center, and $\mathrm{Eu}^{3+}$ was doped into Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf> fibers (referred to as $(\mathrm{YAG}:\mathrm{Eu}^{3+})_{{\mathrm{sf}}}$ later in the paper) by electrostatic spinning method, which makes this fiber with luminescent performance and stress sensing function. The $(YAG:\mathrm{Eu}^{3+})_{\text{sf}}$ reinforced aluminum matrix composites were prepared by vacuum hot press sintering, and the emission spectra of $(\mathrm{YAG}:\mathrm{Eu}^{3+})_{\text{sf}}$ reinforced aluminum matrix composites were recorded by a continuous spectral response system under tensile stresses, and the structural changes within the composites were characterized using in situ XRD, and the relationship between the emission spectra of composites and the internal stresses of materials was analyzed. The relationship between the emission spectra of composites and the internal stresses of the materials was analyzed and empirical equations were established to provide a new method for the failure prediction of composites

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation method for power supply quality of power companies based on two-dimension indexes
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In the electricity market environment, users have the option to choose from different power companies for their electricity needs. This paper proposes a comprehensive evaluation method for power supply quality of power companies based on improved grey correlation analysis, combining the objective power quality and subjective customer evaluation and customized service. To begin with, this method establishes criteria for evaluating power quality, power supply reliability, and economic factors. Subsequently, based on the improved grey correlation analysis method, the evaluation opinions of customers are used as the weights, and the power supply quality of power companies in the same evaluation period is comprehensively evaluated using the method proposed in this paper. Finally, based on the results of an example, the proposed method proves to be efficient in reflecting both objective power supply quality and subjective customer evaluations. As a result, it offers a comprehensive comparison method for the power supply quality of different power companies.

articleTitle: Sensitivity analysis of power quality factors on additional losses of distribution network lines based on Sobol’ method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the expansion of power consumption scale of power system, power quality disturbances are increasing day by day. It is of great significance to study the influence of power quality factors of distribution network on the additional loss of lines. In this paper, Sobol’s global sensitivity analysis method is used to calculate and analyze the first-order sensitivity coefficient (FSC) and total sensitivity coefficient (TSC) of each power quality factor on the additional loss of distribution network lines, taking the additional loss of distribution network lines as the objective function. The results show that Sobol’ method can be used to quantitatively analyze the influence of various power quality factors on the additional loss of distribution network lines. The total sensitivity coefficients of voltage deviation are 1.1709752, which have a great impact on the additional loss of distribution network lines; The total sensitivity coefficients of three-phase current imbalance and harmonics are 25.96 times and 2.28 times of their first order sensitivity coefficients respectively, which indicates that these two parameters have strong interaction with other parameters, and their impact on the additional loss of distribution network lines needs to be considered comprehensively.

Author Keywords: Additional loss of distribution network line

articleTitle: Time-scale-based Analysis of Off-site and On-site Albedo of A Photovoltaic Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the vigorous development of clean energy, photovoltaic (PV) power generation accounts for an increasing proportion of total power generation. The efficiency of photovoltaic power generation is closely related to the albedo of the photovoltaic power plant. In order to improve the efficiency of power generation, it is necessary to deeply analyze the ratio of irradiance received by PV panels and their losses. The data in this paper come from the albedo of a PV power station in Gansu Province, and the analysis shows that the albedo of the station is always higher than the albedo of the station due to the different vegetation cover on the surface of the station, and then the trend of the albedo over time is analyzed in different time scales, and it can be found that the albedo is lower when the irradiance is higher, for example, the noon of a day and the summer of a year; and the albedo is higher when the irradiance is lower, for example, the early morning of a day and the winter of a year. early morning of a day and winter of a year.

articleTitle: Temperature Control of Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell Based on Fuzzy PID
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFC) have high energy density, are environmentally friendly, and have stable operation. They have gradually become the ideal energy device in the transportation and mobile device sectors. However, they have a limited optimal operating temperature range. Therefore, this paper proposes a fuel cell temperature control method based on fuzzy logic algorithm. A fuel cell water and thermal management system model is built based on the Simulink platform to explore the influence of temperature on fuel cell performance by using the model. The controller parameters are optimized and adjusted by fuzzy rules and compared with the traditional PID control method through simulation. The simulation results show that the temperature control of the fuel cell based on fuzzy logic can effectively control the temperature of the fuel cell stack, has better transient response characteristics, and can better meet the practical engineering requirements of PEMFC.

articleTitle: An Improved Quick Design for Axial Flux Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In order to simplify the 3D magnetic circuit Axial flux permanent magnet synchronous machine (AFPMSM) with better Accuracy, the paper proposes an improved equivalent 2D simulation model for the quick design of AFPMSM. Firstly, the generation principle of electromagnetic torque was deduced. Secondly, an equivalent 2D radial flux permanent magnet synchronous machine (RFPMSM) model was presented for AFPMSM with the single stator and single rotor, and then the equivalent of the 2D RFPMSM model was proposed for AFPMSM with the single stator and double rotors. Thirdly, an improved 2D RFPMSM plus model with double air gaps was proposed, which was time-saving and had much more accuracy. based on the comparison and analysis of the calculation results of the equivalent 2D model, the improved equivalent 2D model, as well as the 3D model and the prototype actual testing, it is proven that the improved 2D equivalent model has high simulation Accuracy and quick calculation speed. the improved equivalent 2D model proposed in this paper can quickly design the AFPMSM with a 3D complex magnetic circuit and can get better Accuracy. which provides a simplified direction for AFPMSM and lays a solid foundation for AFPMSM.

Author Keywords: axial flux permanent magnet synchronous machine
radial flux permanent magnet synchronous machine

articleTitle: Review of Bidirectional DC-DC Converters for Electric Vehicle Energy Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Bidirectional DC-DC converters play an important role in the energy management system of electric vehicles by being responsible for the efficient conversion and transmission of electrical energy between the battery and other electronic devices of the electric vehicle. First, the topology of the bidirectional DC-DC converter is analyzed, and the applications in electric vehicles are based on this topology. Second, the control strategies of bidirectional DC-DC converters are summarized, and the advantages and disadvantages of the control strategies of bidirectional DC-DC converters are compared from the perspectives of traditional control strategies and nonlinear control strategies, respectively. Finally, the application of bidirectional DC-DC converters in on-board chargers is analyzed and summarized, and the outlook of the future development direction and challenges are presented.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic Direct Detection Method for Ice Thickness Monitoring of Distribution Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Line icing seriously affects the safe operation of distribution network. On-line monitoring of distribution line operation is of great significance to the safe operation of distribution network. Therefore, this paper presents a direct ultrasonic detection method suitable for monitoring the ice thickness of distribution lines. The method uses the principle of ultrasonic distance measurement to detect the ice thickness of the line. The ice thickness of the line is half of the distance of the ultrasonic wave in the ice sheet. In this paper, an ultrasonic test platform was set up to directly detect the ice thickness of the simulated wire with a steel rod, and the effects of the ultrasonic probe installation mode, ice thickness and the size and shape of the simulated wire on the measurement method were tested. The results showed that the ultrasonic probe was directly attached to the surface of the simulated wire with ultrasonic coupler, and a clear and recognizable waveform could be obtained. Under the circular steel bar, the ultrasonic ice thickness error decreases first and then increases with the increase of the ice thickness, and the maximum error is less than 6%. With the increase of the analog wire size, the ultrasonic ice thickness error decreases gradually, and the minimum error is less than 2%. Under the square steel bar, with the increase of ice thickness, the ultrasonic ice thickness error shows a decreasing trend, and the maximum error is less than 10%.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation strategy of energy storage under carbon trading mechanism counting and demand response
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of wind and light abandonment and grid-connected power shortage caused by the randomness and volatility of new energy output, it is necessary to configure reasonable energy storage to ensure the system to consume the surplus of wind and light and to reduce the power shortage, in order to better tap the demand-side adjustable potential, an optimal allocation strategy of energy storage taking into account the demand response under the carbon trading mechanism is proposed. The strategy establishes an optimal energy storage allocation model based on the demand response and carbon trading mechanism, meets the actual operation and grid-connected power demand of energy storage, takes into account the customer’s satisfaction with electricity consumption, the average time of load transfer and the environmental benefits of new energy sources, and uses particle swarm optimisation algorithms to solve the model with the optimisation goal of maximising the revenue under the scenario of new energy consumption. Comparative analysis shows that: carbon trading mechanism and demand response can significantly reduce the demand for energy storage configuration, improve the energy storage utilisation rate and new energy consumption rate, which is significantly affected by the electricity price and carbon trading price, and the development of reasonable carbon trading price and flexible electricity price can help to improve the economy of energy storage configuration, which has a positive effect on promoting the investment and construction of energy storage.

articleTitle: Effect of Dielectric Barrier Discharge Plasma actuator on the Wake Region of Tandem Double Cylinders
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Based on the plasma phenomenological model, the potential and net charge density are obtained by solving the Poisson equation and the charge density distribution equation, and the volume force is unidirectionally coupled to the flow field control equation to explore the effect of plasma discharge on the flow field in the wake region of tandem double cylinders at different incoming velocities. The simulation results show that when the plasma actuator is applied, the velocity and pressure in the wake region of the tandem double cylinders are well restored, and the effect becomes weaker with the increase of the incoming flow velocity.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of Solar Solenoid Valve
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Based on the dual carbon target and the solenoid valve technology, this paper designs a solenoid valve system which can save energy, resist freezing and reduce carbon emission. Studying the impact of external environment on electromagnetic valves in cold regions, designing the theoretical structure of the electromagnetic valve, and conducting theoretical calculations and analysis of the energy consumption of the electromagnetic valve under design conditions, the power of the electromagnetic valve was calculated to be 29W. A 10W solar photovoltaic cell module and 82.53Ah storage tanks were selected to complete the design of the solar photovoltaic power generation system. Use Simulink to model and simulate the tracking of the maximum power point of solar cells, and select the incremental conductivity method as the tracking method for the maximum power point of the photovoltaic power generation system, the standard coal emission reduction is 92.51kg, carbon dioxide emission reduction is 268.32kg, sulfur dioxide emission reduction is 1.67kg, dust emission reduction is 0.66kg, and nitrogen oxide emission reduction is 0.25kg.

articleTitle: Research on Channel Modeling and Topology Performance Analysis of PLC Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: At present, the existing research on power line communication only focuses on simple networking forms, such as bus networks. Most importantly, it lacks theoretical analysis and networking suggestions for complex communication network channel characteristics. In view of the above problems, based on the two-port network channel model of transmission line, this paper proposes tree and star networking forms based on the known bus network topology, and establishes the mathematical model of its channel. Finally, the channel characteristics of the three topologies in different scenarios such as transmission distance, node distribution and branch number are simulated and analyzed. After research, the star topology has better channel characteristics. This paper puts forward relevant suggestions for power line communication networking, which has certain guiding significance for the actual deployment of power line communi-cation network.

articleTitle: Deployment Scheme for Source-Grid-Load-Storage Integrated System Based on OS2
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The construction of new power system with new energy as the principal part is being promoted, which poses challenges to the safety, economy, and stability of the power system. It requires more regulatory resources and stronger regulatory capabilities. Based on the integrated power grid operation smart system (OS2) of China Southern Power Grid, a deployment architecture for source-grid-load-storage collaborative control is proposed. In this architecture, the source-grid-load-storage collaborative control platform is deployed in Zone III, which can expand the functions of OS2 through data and model interaction, and realize the full control of the source-grid-load-storage resources, ensuring the information exchange security of the smart grid. It is a reasonable and applicable regulatory system construction plan in the construction process of the new power system.

articleTitle: Feasibility analysis of thermal and electrical multigeneration energy supply system for existing single building
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The traditional energy supply method of building in northwest rural area is inconvenient and the environment pollution is serious. Taking a 150m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> single building in a new village in Zhangye City, Gansu Province as the research object, this paper designed a set of thermal and electrical multigeneration energy supply system which uses solar energy and biomass energy as input energy and effectively combines photovoltaic power generation system, solar heating system and solar thermostatic biogas production device. TRNSYS software was used to simulate the operation of the system. The system can run normally, the room temperature and solar irradiance curves are obtained, and the performance of the system is analyzed. The design can solve the shortage of energy supply in the northwest countryside, and build a multi-generation heating system for the new rural single buildings, which can continuously and stably supply heat, power and biogas to users.

articleTitle: Echos, Suggestions, and Directions on New Energy Development in China under the Grid Parity
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: After the development of China’s new energy through ’golden decade’, based on the information released by the National Energy Administration from 2011 to 2019, this article comprehensively reviews the development history of China new energy in the past ten years, analyzes the background of China new energy parity online in the new era under the background of the national energy clean transformation, and suggests eight drives for promoting parity online after the rapid development of China new energy in ten years. Finally, the directions of China new energy resources after parity is predicted in the short and long term, which can provide reference for the healthy development of China’s new energy resources in the future.

articleTitle: Optimization Operation Strategy of Distributed Energy Aggregator in VPP
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Under the background of high penetration of distributed energy resource (DER) and gradual deepening of marketization reform of the electricity market, this paper analyzes the bidding strategy of distributed energy resource aggregators (DERs) participating in the day-ahead (DA) and real-time (RT) market. This problem can be expressed by a stochastic robust optimization model to solve their optimal returns in the power market, in which stochastic scenarios are used to simulate the uncertainty of market price and wind power generation output in the power market. By using confidence intervals to handle the uncertainty of the charging demand for electric vehicles (EVs), and solving the stochastic robust optimization model, bidding strategies for purchasing and selling electricity in the DA market and RT market at different periods were obtained. The effectiveness of this model has been verified through practical operational data examples.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Assessment Method for Power Quality Based on Rough AHP and Improved TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the widespread use of nonlinear and asymmetric loads in power systems, the assessment of power quality has increasingly drawn the attention of scholars. The essence of power quality evaluation lies in a multi-attribute decision optimization problem. To address the critical issue of determining the weights of power quality indicators, a method combining Rough Analytic Hierarchy Process (RAHP) and improved Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) is proposed. This method first calculates the weights of indicators using RAHP, and then applies the improved TOPSIS method to comprehensively evaluate the power quality at five measurement points of a substation bus. The results of the case study demonstrate that the proposed method adequately considers both subjective and objective factors, resulting in a more comprehensive and accurate assessment.

articleTitle: Virtual Inertial Control Strategy of DC Microgrid Based on Improved Model Prediction Control
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the bus voltage in low-inertia DC microgrid is prone to be affected by internal power fluctuations, a virtual inertial control strategy of DC microgrid based on improved model prediction control is proposed. Firstly, analog virtual synchronous generator (AVSG) control is introduced into the voltage outer loop, and the inertia of DC microgrid is improved by introducing virtual capacitance and damping coefficient. Secondly, in order to avoid the lag phenomenon caused by control delay, an improved model predictive control is introduced into the current inner loop to achieve fast tracking of the current set value, while eliminating the traditional PI controller and PWM regulator, thus improving the dynamic performance of the control system. Finally, a system model is established based on Matlab/Simulink for simulation. The results show that compared with the traditional PI-based virtual inertia control strategy, the proposed control strategy in this paper has smaller bus voltage fluctuation amplitude and better dynamic performance, which can effectively improve the stability of DC bus voltage and the inertia of DC microgrid.

articleTitle: The improvement of YOLOv5s algorithm for real-time detection of vehicle targets
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In response to the existing target detection algorithm in urban road vehicle detection, there are problems such as low detection accuracy, poor real-time and robustness, etc., and propose a method of vehicle target detection to improve YOLOv5s. First of all, optimize the YOLOv5s algorithm network structure, and use increasing the detection layer of small targets to improve the accuracy of the detection of small targets; then use CIOU instead of Giou as the border frame regression loss function, solving the border frame that contains each other to compare with length and width. Question; then use the Hardswish activation function on the entire network model for convolution operations. In order to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm in this article, we will test the improved algorithm on the UA-DETRAC dataset. The experimental results show that the accuracy of target detection (Precision) increased by 2.46%, the recall rate (Recall) increased by 5.5%, and the average accuracy (mAP) increased by 2.19% Vehicle goals.

articleTitle: Modeling the Impact of Electrode Material Structure on the Performance of Lithium-Ion Batteries: Effects of Porosity and Particle Size
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: This study investigates the effects of porosity and particle size of electrode material particles on the performance of LiFePO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> batteries using COMSOL software. A Newman model of a LiFePO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-graphite lithium-ion battery is constructed and solved to analyze the impacts of different particle sizes on cell performance and ion/electron transport rate. Based on this, a 3D heterogeneous lithium-ion battery model is developed and solved to examine the effects of various particle porosities on the ion/electron transport rate. The results show that reducing particle size and increasing porosity enhance the performance of lithium-ion batteries. This is attributed to the influence of particle size and porosity on lithium ion diffusion and electrode current density. Overall, optimizing the structure of electrode material particles has the potential to enhance the performance of lithium-ion batteries, providing valuable guidance for battery design and material selection.

articleTitle: Layout of Wind Turbines on a Trapzoidal Hill
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Layout of wind farm on a hilltop is studied through numerical simulation. Site selection of wind turbine on top of typical hill terrain is a common problem for construction of wind farms on complex terrain. Acceleration of wind on the hillside and uneven distribution of velocity field over the hilltop complicate this problem. Wind velocity is not homogeneous on the top of hill, different positions of wind turbine result in different velocity deficits and power output. Four cases of wind turbines on different positions of a trapezoidal hilltop, as well as the flow over the hill, are simulated. The analysis of the data provides a reference for optimizing the micro site selection of wind farms.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Power Prediction Considering Direct and Scattered Radiation Effect
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) power prediction is of great significance in grid optimization and dispatch. Aiming at the situation that most prediction models only use one type of irradiance as input, this paper discusses the influence of different types of irradiances on the accuracy of PV power prediction. In this paper, four types of irradiances are input into BP neural network, Elman neural network, and RF neural network for training and testing, using the real irradiance of a PV power plant in Gansu Province, China, and other meteorological data. The results show that all three models have higher accuracy when the irradiance is a combination of total, direct, and scattered radiation, and the Elman model has the lowest prediction error. The method can be widely applied to most models to achieve higher accuracy in PV power prediction.

articleTitle: Comparison of PEMFC performance with parallel-serpentine flow field under various geometrical conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: To study the effect of the number of parallel serpentine flow channels on the performance of proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC), a multi physical field simulation software COMSOL was used to simulate the flow channel structures with different number of channels. The effects of the number of channels on the pressure drop and fluid mass flow rate in the channels were analyzed. The results show that with the number of flow channels increases, the drainage capacity and the power density also increases, but at the same time, it also increases the pressure drop inside the flow channel.

articleTitle: The influence of electric vehicle access on highway optical storage DC microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of new energy vehicles in the world’s highway transportation network, the degree of electrmcation of transportation is also deepening, and the electrical coupling between the power grid and the transportation network is gradually strengthened. The two will form an energy and geographical coupling network, which poses new challenges to researchers. The sections along the expressway have good large-scale development endowment of new energy. At the same time, as a green and low-carbon means of transportation, electric vehicles will eventually be connected to the highway microgrid on a large scale with the gradual improvement of highway charging facilities. Therefore, this paper first assumes that electric vehicles connected to the highway microgrid do not need to wait for immediate charging behavior every time they are connected to the grid until the end of full charging. Using Monte Carlo simulation, the upper and lower limits of the charging power of the electric vehicle charging 24 hours a day are obtained. After fitting the upper and lower limits of the charging power of the electric vehicle charging 24 hours a day, the charging power of the electric vehicle charging 24 hours a day is obtained. As a variable power load connected to the optical storage DC microgrid, simulink modeling is carried out to study the impact of electric vehicle access on the stability of the highway optical storage DC microgrid before and after the comparison.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Wind-solar Trusted Capacity for Desert UHVDC Transmission Base
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The scenic and credible capacity of new energy ultra-high voltage direct current transmission system (UHVDC) transmission base in desert areas can provide support for the planning and construction of large-scale new energy UHVDC transmission base. For this scenario, a new trusted capacity evaluation method combining Equivalent Firm Capacity (EFC) and Equivalent load-carrying Capability (ELCC) is proposed, which considers the load is not fixed and the power generation side is not fixed. Firstly, the mathematical models of wind power, photovoltaic, thermal power and UHVDC transmission were established, and then the trusted capacity of wind power was calculated by Monte Carlo simulation. Finally, the trusted capacity of wind power under different access modes was solved by simulation examples, and the influence of different proportions of wind power installed capacity on the trusted capacity was analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on network intrusion detection based on Whitening PCA and CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In the face of a large number of network attacks, intrusion detection system can issue early warning, indicating the emergence of network attacks. In order to improve the traditional machine learning network intrusion detection model to identify the behavior of network attacks, improve the detection accuracy and accuracy. Convolutional neural network is used to construct intrusion detection model, which has better ability to solve complex problems and better adaptability of algorithm. In order to solve the problems such as dimension explosion caused by input data, the albino PCA algorithm is used to extract data features and reduce data dimensions. For the common problem of convolutional neural networks in intrusion detection such as overfitting, Dropout layers are added before and after the fully connected layer of CNN, and Sigmoid is selected as the intrusion classification prediction function. This reduces the overfitting, improves the robustness of the intrusion detection model, and enhances the fault tolerance and generalization ability of the model to improve the accuracy of the intrusion detection model. The effectiveness of the proposed method in intrusion detection is verified by comparison and analysis of numerical examples.

articleTitle: Exploration and practice of guarding against icing on distribution network lines in southern region
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The distribution network directly faces the power demand of large number of users, accounting for a large proportion of the entire power network, but its own level of guarding against icing is low, some of southern region distribution network line grid is still weak currently. It is particularly important to comprehensively analyze and summarize the icing d damage of the distribution network in the southern region, propose better technical and management measures for pre-disaster prevention, disaster response and post-disaster recovery, and improve the ability of the distribution network to withstand ice disasters. This paper introduces the exploration and practice of guarding against icing on distribution network lines in southern region during cold wave. The causes of damage of distribution network equipment under ice disaster are analyzed. The damaged cases of distribution network poles and lines are analyzed. The application of icing disaster prevention technology in distribution network is introduced. At present, there are still many shortcomings in guarding against icing on distribution network. In order to meet the development requirements of the essential safety of distribution lines and the intelligent power grid in China, the distribution network needs new technologies to reduce line tripping and equipment damage to meet the requirements of the medium and long-term development planning of the power grid.

articleTitle: Highway Load Forecasting Method Based on BP Neural Network and Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: This study presents a novel approach to expressway load forecasting by integrating the BP neural network and Monte Carlo simulation techniques. Firstly, a comprehensive analysis is conducted to identify and classify different types of loads on highways into periodic and non-periodic categories based on their distinct characteristics. For periodic loads, the proposed algorithm utilizes a BP neural network-based model for accurate prediction. On the other hand, for non-periodic loads, a Monte Carlo simulation-based algorithm is employed for prediction purposes. To validate the effectiveness of the developed methodology, field investigations and data collection are carried out along the stretch from Yongdeng Service Area to Huining Service Area of G30 Lianhuo Expressway. The simulation results demonstrate the high accuracy of the proposed model in load prediction. In comparison with existing literature’s prediction methods, our approach proves to be more comprehensive and yields results that closely align with real-world observations.

articleTitle: Challenges and Suggestions for Building a High Resilience Green Power Grid in Northwest China under the Background of “Dual Carbon”
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The characteristics and measures of the high resilience transmission end power grid under the background of building a new power system in the northwest region. As an important energy base in China, the northwest occupies an important position in China’s energy security strategy. Against the backdrop of actively promoting the “dual carbon” and green and clean energy transformation nationwide, as an important clean energy base in China, the role of the Northwest region is becoming increasingly prominent. But at the same time, with the increasing proportion of new energy installed capacity, the security risk of power grid and the pressure on the security and supply of power energy are increasing. It is necessary to think about how to ensure the safe and stable operation of power grid under the ultra-high proportion from the Systems thinking and overall perspective. In response to this background, this article first summarizes the achievements of new energy development in China and the northwest region, analyzes the challenges faced, proposes the concept of building a high resilience transmission end power grid to promote the construction of a high proportion of new energy power grids in the northwest, and proposes corresponding opinions and measures.

Author Keywords: High toughness transmission end power grid

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Three-phase PWM Rectifier Based on Soft Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In the digital control system for high-power three-phase PWM rectifier, the selection of PI control parameters is very hard because of the fast load change and dynamic response speed. Therefore, a new control strategy based on soft computing was proposed. By combining fuzzy neural networks with traditional control strategies, this new control strategy can adaptively select PI control parameters.The circuit was built using Matlab simulation software and the control strategy was verified through simulation. The simulation results show that the control strategy is effective. And compared with traditional PI control methods, the new control strategy can improve the dynamic response characteristics and robustness of the system.

articleTitle: A novel approach for assessing the operational status of a regional intelligent distribution network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The intelligent distribution network, as a crucial component of the smart grid, represents the future direction of power distribution. It serves as an effective means to achieve energy efficiency, enhance power supply reliability, and reduce line losses. However, due to its large scale, high complexity, and susceptibility to various factors, traditional management methods struggle to meet modern requirements. Therefore, the scientific and rational assessment of the operational status of the intelligent distribution network has become an unresolved issue. In this study, we focus on a regional distribution network in Shanxi province. We have constructed a comprehensive set of scientifically and rationally designed evaluation indicators for assessing the operational status of the intelligent distribution network. Furthermore, the CRITIC method has been employed for weight assignment, while the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method has been utilized to establish a comprehensive assessment model for the intelligent distribution network. Through practical case validation, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed approach have been verified.

articleTitle: A Series-connected 24-pulse Rectifier for Direct-drive Wind Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In traditional direct-drive wind power generation systems based on diode rectification units, the nonlinearity of rectifying diodes can lead to severe harmonic pollution. In order to improve the harmonic suppression capability of the diode rectification unit, this paper proposes a 24-pulse rectifier based on passive harmonic suppression method on the DC side. This rectifier utilizes a passive harmonic suppression circuit to modulate and generate square wave circulating currents, increasing the number of rectifier pulses from 12 to 24. Firstly, the working principle of the diode rectifier is analyzed. Secondly, the mechanism of harmonic suppression in the rectifier is explained, and the turns ratio of the injection transformer is designed and optimized with the objective of minimizing current harmonics. Theoretical analysis and simulation verification demonstrate that this rectifier has strong harmonic suppression capability and high reliability, making it suitable for direct-drive wind power generation systems.

articleTitle: Control strategy of EMA servo drive system based on PID neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Flap electromechanical actuator (EMA) is a class of actuators that convert electrical energy into mechanical energy to drive mechanical loads in a multi-electric aircraft In this paper, for the flap electro-mechanical actuator servo system, taking the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) as the control object, a PID neural network-based flap electromechanical actuator control method is proposed, and the SVPWM vector control strategy is applied to the PMSM control; a three-closed-loop servo control system for the flap EMA is designed. The effects of voltage fluctuation and sudden load change on the flap EMA servo control system are investigated. The simulation results show that the EMA three-closed-loop servo control strategy based on PID neural network has good dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of junction temperature characteristics of IGBT module in wind power converter
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: IGBT is the key device to realize power conversion and control in wind power converter. The life of IGBT in wind power converter is closely related to the random fluctuation of wind speed. The random change of wind speed in wind power generation system makes the output power of wind turbine and the loss of wind power converter device change, and the thermal cycle of the device will fluctuate accordingly. The fluctuation of the thermal cycle of the device will lead to the increase of the junction temperature of the device. In order to prolong the life of IGBT, it is necessary to ensure that the working temperature of the device is within a safe range. Therefore, studying the relationship between the junction temperature of the wind power converter IGBT and its life under actual wind speed can reduce the failure rate of the wind power generation system. Firstly, by analyzing the characteristics of wind speed in wind farm, this paper analyzes the factors affecting the output power of wind turbine, and establishes the wind speed characterization model of wind turbine output power. At the same time, the multi-physical field electro-thermal coupling simulation model of IGBT in wind power converter is built by using Comsol software to realize the coupling simulation of current field and thermal field under different wind speeds, and the distribution law of IGBT junction temperature fluctuation is obtained.

articleTitle: A System Configuration description Language (SCL) Complied File Based Configuration Method for Bridges in Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Configuration of smart substation network which composed by bridges and IEDs (Intelligent Electronic Devices), always faces complicated pre-planning and commissioning work and involved with multiple vendors and various configuration file format. BCD (Bridge Configuration Description) file brought in this document is a SCL rule complied file format that composes of only necessary information for substation network bridges to do the IED-learning and establish GOOSE/SV (Generic Object-Oriented Substation Event/Sampled Value) paths, such as GOOSE/SV association and IED definition. All the information in BCD file is extracted from SCD (System Configuration Description) file and IID (Instantiated of IED Description) file without changing to keep the files synchronization. The IID file is specially used to accommodate the information of silent IEDs which cannot be integrated into the SCD file. Compared with the method of using SCD file to configure the network, the proposed BCD file is extremely light weighted, which can implement the same goal. How to use the BCD file to perform IED-learning and generate bridge configuration are provided in this paper to help understand the method application and the principle of substation network auto-routing.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Distribution Network Response Potential Superiority for Transmission and Distribution Coordination
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the development of new energy and active distribution network, the collaborative interaction between the transmission network and distribution network will become more and more frequent. In this paper, the comprehensive evaluation index of distribution network response potential superiority is constructed. The quantitative evaluation method of distribution network response potential superiority is established by using the subjective and objective evaluation method, combining information entropy and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, which provides a reference for mobilizing the transmission and distribution collaboration potential of different types of distribution networks.

articleTitle: Edge Load Prediction Method of Distribution Network Based On K-Nearest Neighbor Mutual Information Feature Simplification
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: During the construction of power distribution network, the number of the most basic sensing devices has increased substantially, which brings great pressure to the transmission, storage and computing of power data. Edge computing technology can process more valuable local data, which can save time and energy costs. In this paper, an edge load fore casting method based on k-nearest neighbor mutual information characteristics is proposed, which is suitable for distribution network. This method uses the k-nearest neighbor method to estimate the mutual information between multidimensional input vector and output vector. The feature selection part can simplify the operation and save the edge calculated energy consumption. This paper adopts the mutual information feature selection method based on k-nearest neighbor estimation, which is suitable for the screening of high-dimensional feature variables, and realizes the integral simplification of load pre diction method based on deep recurrent neural network. It can improve the efficiency of some edge computing tasks in the region and propose the edge computing architecture of distribution Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Research on MPPT Strategy of Bifacial Photovoltaic Power Generation System Based on PSO
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Driven} by the goal of “double carbon”, bifacial photovoltaic (PV) modules have become a new favorite in the industry due to their high conversion efficiency, high power generation capacity, and manufacturing process costs similar to those of conventional modules. The purpose of this paper is to study the maximum power point tracking control of bifacial photovoltaic power generation systems. Considering the characteristics of bifacial photovoltaic cells that can receive radiation on both sides, an irradiance model is combined with a light tracking model to construct a model for bifacial photovoltaic modules. Firstly, the mathematical model and irradiance model of the bifacial photovoltaic power generation system are established. Secondly, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to track the maximum power point of the bifacial photovoltaic power generation system. Finally, experimental verification is conducted through MATLAB/ Simulink simulation. The experimental results show that the output power of the bifacial photovoltaic power generation system can be increased by 30% compared to the single-sided photovoltaic power generation system. Additionally, the results verify the superiority of the particle swarm optimization algorithm in maximum power tracking. The simulation results demonstrate that the particle swarm optimization algorithm for bifacial PV power generation systems outperforms traditional maximum power tracking algorithms in terms of output power tracking speed and accuracy. This provides important practical application value for improving the efficiency of PV cells.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor Detection and Estimation Fusion by Minimizing Improved Minkowski Distance
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the problem of multi-sensor joint detection and parameter estimation fusion under inaccessible prior probability, in which numbers of sensor nodes collaborate to make a decision between two hypotheses and estimate the unknown parameter and the guess of true prior associated with the decided hypothesis simultaneously in the fusion center. Firstly, we derive the multi-sensor joint likelihood function under either hypothesis by the property of the products and convolutions of Gaussian probability density functions. Then, the optimal decision rule is obtained by building and solving an unconstrained optimization model that maximizes the weighted combination of the expected utility and the average detection probability. Finally, an improved Minkowski distance measure method is given to choose the optimal guess of the true prior probability. Simulation results show the superiority of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Technology Architecture for Source-Grid-Load-Storage Collaborative Control
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The construction of a new type of power system requires the exploration of the collaborative control potential of source-grid-load-storage. To meet the demands of the development of the new power system, this paper proposes a technology architecture oriented towards source-grid-load-storage collaborative control. The technology architecture of grid-load-storage is an innovative design that integrates multiple systems and resources, aiming to achieve collaborative control and optimization of energy. This architecture integrates power sources, power grids, load management, and energy storage systems, breaking down the traditional boundaries between systems and enabling efficient synergistic utilization of resources. By applying advanced artificial intelligence and big data analysis technologies, this architecture can achieve real-time monitoring and prediction of the power system, thus more accurately forecasting power demand and supply situations. Its intelligent scheduling and control capabilities enable finer energy allocation, faster response times, and better adaptation to the variability and uncertainty of the power system.

articleTitle: Network Topology Transformation Method Suitable for Complex Fault Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In this paper, oriented to the fault types in the electromagnetic transient simulation of grid operation mode calculation, the program analysis method of the fault file that describes the fault is studied, and the data structure used to describe the electromagnetic transient fault in the program is designed. For complex faults that consider the randomness of the fault location of the fault element and the action of the circuit breaker, research the electromagnetic network topology transformation method covering chain operations such as node splitting, component splitting, switching action, and fault setting. Research and develop electromagnetic transient simulation fault handling programs that support faults of bus, line, transformer, and converter, etc. Finally the correctness of the program is verified.

articleTitle: DC Fault Ride-through Strategy for Modified Series Single Chain-link Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: This paper presents a DC fault ride-through strategy for modified series single chain-link modular multilevel converter (MSSC-MMC). Although the Modular multilevel converter (MMC) has good application prospects in medium-voltage DC distribution networks, the series single chain-link modular multilevel converter (SSC-MMC) has more significant advantages in reducing the number of sub-modules (SMs), equipment costs, and volume. In DC distribution networks, DC short circuit fault is an important challenge that must be considered and addressed. The existing DC fault ride-through strategy based on modified MMC mainly includes blocking protection and voltage regulation operation. The blocking method can effectively control fault current, but restarting is more difficult. The voltage regulation operation strategy makes restarting easier, but the fault current will be relatively high. Due to the different topological structures between SSC-MMC and MMC, the above approach cannot be directly applied to SSCMMC-based systems. Therefore, a modified topology of SSCMMC and the corresponding DC fault ride-through strategy is proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Fast Prediction of Thermal Behaviour of Lithium-ion Battery Energy Storage Systems Based on Meshless Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Accurate and efficient temperature monitoring is crucial for the rational control and safe operation of battery energy storage systems. Due to the limited number of temperature collection sensors in the energy storage system, it is not possible to quickly obtain the temperature distribution in the whole domain, and it is difficult to evaluate the heat production behavior of the battery in real time. Numerical simulation has the ability to obtain the temperature distribution in the whole domain, but the computational efficiency is low, and the arithmetic power demand is large, which can not be directly applied to the online temperature monitoring and heat production evaluation of the system. In this paper, based on the CFD simulation of a battery module, combined with machine learning algorithms, a meshless surrogate model construction method is proposed to obtain the surrogate model of wind speed, time and node temperature. The analysis of different wind speed test cases shows that the surrogate model is able to complete the evolution of the whole field temperature distribution of the battery module during the discharge process of 1 C times in 2.6 s. Compared with the CFD simulation, the computational speed is increased by 1229 times, and the absolute error of the temperature is less than 0.023 K. The surrogate model is able to realize the application of complex numerical models in the online simulation of actual engineering, which provides a new idea for the monitoring and control of the temperature of the energy storage system

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation Analysis of Typical Series Parallel Hybrid Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Aiming at the simulation modeling and analysis problem of a series-parallel hybrid vehicle, this paper establishes a series parallel hybrid vehicle model, and simulates and analyzes it from the aspects of economy, power and mode switching. Firstly, the vehicle power configuration and modes of series-parallel hybrid vehicles are analyzed and studied, and a series and parallel hybrid vehicle mode switching control model and torque distribution strategy of hybrid vehicles based on logic threshold values are further constructed in the MATLAB/Simulink platform. Through joint simulation with VPAT, the economic simulation test is carried out under WLTC working conditions, which verifies the accuracy of the established vehicle model and the reliability of vehicle mode switching.

articleTitle: Detection of Dissolved Acetylene in Transformer Oil Based on Single-Fiber Photoacoustic Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: A detection technology based on single-fiber photoacoustic sensor for detecting dissolved acetylene gas in oil was proposed. The photoacoustic sensor integrated a photoacoustic cell and a Fabry-Perot (F-P) interference cavity. The volume of the air chamber is only 14.1 μtecting dissolved acetylene gasL. The excitation and detection light were simultaneously coupled into the photoacoustic cell by using a 1x2 fiber coupler. In order to reduce the noise and improve the photoacoustic signal, the modulation frequency was selected to be 1 kHz. A silicon cantilever was utilized to detect the amplitude of the generated photoacoustic signal. To eliminate the interference of the laser-reflected light, a part of the F-P interference spectrum was used for phase demodulation to achieve a highly sensitive detection of the photoacoustic signal.
