By optimizing the modulation parameters, the minimum detection limit of the sensor was achieved to be 0.2 ppm. The single-fiber photoacoustic sensor has a good significance for analysis of dissolved gases in transformer oil.

Author Keywords: analysis of dissolved gases in oil

articleTitle: Design of Multistage Auxiliary Thermal Anaerobic Digestion Device in Cold Area
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Considering the cold winter climate in Northwest China and the low efficiency of anaerobic fermentation, and even the phenomenon of fermentation stagnation or failure, this paper intends to design a solar energy and electrochemical multistage auxiliary thermal anaerobic digestion device. The solar collector can achieve the auxiliary thermal effect under the condition of light, and the electrochemical auxiliary thermal device is used as the auxiliary thermal means under the condition of no light. MATLAB was used to simulate and analyze the device, and the results showed that the designed multistage auxiliary thermal anaerobic digestion device could run stably in the cold area for a long time, meet the temperature required by anaerobic fermentation, improve the energy utilization rate, reduce the emission of pollutants, and provide a new technical scheme for the utilization of biomass resources in Northwest China.

articleTitle: Dynamic risk assessment of thermal fault in distribution station by online analysis of cloud model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Power distribution station plays a vital role in the entire power system. How to assess the risk level of an unattended distribution station is an important topic. This study proposes a dynamic risk assessment method of thermal fault based on the cloud model, order relationship analysis, and entropy weight method. Three indexes: temperature, temperature rise, and interphase temperature difference are selected to make a reasonable judgment of equipment thermal fault. The order relationship analysis method and entropy weight method are utilized to calculate the weight of the indexes, and then the calculated data is sent to the cloud model to generate a qualitative concept of the risk level. The numerical test shows that the proposed method can accurately reflect the risk level of the equipment. The cloud model can convert the quantitative value of equipment to a qualitative concept. Moreover, the cloud model can deal with abnormal condition when the data acquisition contains faulty data, avoiding the fault alarm.

articleTitle: MILP Algorithm Based Control Method for Microgrid Energy Supply Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Under the background of “two-carbon” target, the microgrid of “source-network-load-storage” structure, as an important intermediary for realizing multi-energy complementarity, multi-energy coupling, and multi-object scheduling, has gradually become a key research object in the academic community. This paper firstly introduces the “source- network-load-storage” microgrid model and its components, and lists the scheduling examples based on this model. Based on the existing research results, this paper selects the wind and photovoltaic power output on a certain day as the research object, and establishes the basic scheduling model based on stochastic planning model, then establishes linear constraints and introduces relaxation factors, and finally solves the problem by using linear programming algorithm. Finally, this paper selects the standard IEEE-30 node model as the scheduling object and establishes a linear algorithm scheduling model. Based on this, the CPLEX solver is then used to carry out linear programming to obtain a cost-minimizing scheduling scheme, and at the same time, scheduling is carried out in the dynamic time sequence, and the rolling distribution of wind and solar power output power, so as to achieve the maximization of the value of the consumption of renewable energy sources and the minimization of the total cost.

articleTitle: Research on the feasibility of realization for “West-to-East Hydrogen Transmission” with green ammonia
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Hydrogen energy is an important way to realize energy security and dual-carbon goals, and it is one of the important directions for the development of new energy in the world. research and development of “West-to-East Hydrogen Transmission” can effectively alleviate the problem of mismatch of resources between east and west in China. In this paper, analyzes the technical feasibility of green ammonia hydrogen storage from four aspects: technical characteristics, technical maturity, standard system and market application. Then takes the transportation from Jiuquan City, Gansu Province to Shanghai City as an example, constructs a supply chain model including hydrogen production, medium, transportation, reduction and distribution links, and analyzes the economic feasibility of green ammonia hydrogen storage by measuring the comprehensive cost of the whole process of supply chain,and analyzes the carbon emissions. The comprehensive study shows that using green ammonia as the storage medium is a feasible path to realize the “West-to-East Hydrogen Transmission

articleTitle: The Configuration of Medium Voltage Distribution Transformer for Extremely High Voltage Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Transformer is the most important component in power distribution design, and its long-term operation cost determines the operation cost of power distribution system. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze the transformer configuration considering efficiency and economy for extremely high voltage laboratory, which is used for study the lightning impact and protection of aircraft. In this paper, a medium voltage distribution system is designed to adapt the operation of extremely high voltage laboratory for lightning test. We analyze the basic information such as the type of distribution transformer, power loss and core material Then the model and capacity selection of the transformer are calculated and compared based on the actual load category and operation curve. According to the above analysis, a transformer configuration network with the lowest total cost in thirty years is proposed. This scheme provides the technical support for the implementation of aircraft lightning protection experiments. At the same time, the research can also be extended to power generation and distribution, laboratories or buildings with similar power architecture, which has promising application value.

articleTitle: Research on Output Characteristics of the Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell Based on Model Reference Adaptive Control
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell (PEMFC) is a complex system which is multi-input and multi-output, nonlinear, and strongly coupled. During variable loading, the output power and voltage show large amplitude fluctuations, slow regulation, and other factors. This paper proposes a method of model reference adaptive control based on Lyapunov stability theory. A dynamic model of PEMFC with multiple inputs and outputs considering the phenomenon of the “double charge layer” is established. An adaptive controller is designed based on characteristic parameters of the model, and adaptive control law is regulated through the use of Lyapunov stability theory to enhance system’s robustness. Simulation results indicate that output characteristics of the PEMFC dynamic model are improved under model reference adaptive control when load current changes abruptly, resulting in a 4.32% reduction in overshoot and a 0.36 second reduction in regulation time, as compared to traditional PID control. The PEMFC dynamic model and model reference adaptive control strategy are verified to be accurate and stable, which is of considerable significance in improving energy conversion efficiency and extending service life of the stack.

articleTitle: Optimization study of electric vehicle charging station load model prediction based on Kalman filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: A large amount of charging load of electric vehicles will impact the local power grid, in order to improve the accuracy of short-term charging load prediction of electric vehicle(EV) charging station, a short-term charging load prediction method of charging station based on Kalman filter is proposed. Firstly, in the day-ahead stage, the charging loads at 24 scales of a day are predicted and an optimization model with the objective of minimizing the daily charging cost is established; secondly, in the intra-day stage, model predictive control is adopted to achieve rolling optimization, and the influence of uncertainty factors at the EV charging station during charging is eliminated to a greater extent based on Kalman filtering. Finally, taking the data of an electric vehicle charging station as an example, the data are analyzed through an arithmetic example, and the results are compared and verified with the results of the prediction model based on BP neural network and ARIMA, and the results show that the prediction control model based on Kalman filter could effectively improve the load prediction accuracy of electric vehicle charging stations.

articleTitle: Feasibility analysis of biogas cogeneration ecological toilet
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Due to the low winter temperature and lack of water resources in northwest China, the promotion and development of water-flush toilets have been limited. Combined with the abundant solar energy resources in Northwest China and the biogas digester built. A set of multi-generation ecological toilet was constructed, which combined toilet renovation and multi-generation supply. Taking the typical new rural toilets in the cold areas of northern China as the research object, the balance of supply and demand, equipment and operation performance were studied from the perspective of multi-level energy consumption requirements of users. The results show that the load of the system matches well with the toilet of rural residents, and the daily methane output is basically maintained at about 1.48m3. Compared with the traditional toilet, the system can save 652.62kWh of electricity, 21608L of water, and the emission reduction of $CO_{2}1000kg, SO_{2}30kg$ and $NO_{X}15kg$, and the annual cost is saved 750 yuan.

articleTitle: Instantaneous Frequency Measurement and Tracking under Out of Step Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: As an important operating parameter of the power system, the instantaneous frequency of the current can reflect the actual operating state of the current system, especially when the system is out of step. The characteristics of the current in the oscillation line are analyzed in this paper. An algorithm for measuring instantaneous frequency of current while power system swings is presented, based on the broad definition of angular frequency. According to the feature of the actual power system, a new method for measuring the instantaneous current frequency by real-time sampling is proposed. Finally, the algorithm is simulated on the model of the equivalent systems. When the system swings, the real-time frequency is gained by sampling the current in the line, combined with the frequency of the equivalent machine of both sides. It shows that the obtained current frequency is reasonable and effective, compared to the characteristics of the system.

articleTitle: Study on the characteristics of space charge in welded IGBT
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the performance requirements of insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) in various fields in power electronic systems, the requirements of IGBT power modules for package insulation are also increasing. Among them, space charge has a great influence on the package insulation of IGBT. However, the influence of space charge on the package insulation reliability of high voltage power modules has not been systematically studied. Therefore, in order to study the charge dynamics in the packaging structure of IGBT module, this paper takes the common welded IGBT as the starting point, based on the bipolar charge transfer model and the finite element method, uses the custom partial differential equation and the electrostatic field physical field to simulate in software. The potential, electric field strength and space charge density of the welded IGBT module under the two conditions of substrate grounding and potential suspension are compared and analyzed. The electric field strength and space charge density of the welded IGBT module under the constant DC source and the DC square wave are compared and analyzed. At the same time, the electric field intensity and space charge density at different times under the condition of applying DC square wave are compared and analyzed. According to the simulation results, the space charge accumulation is less when the bottom substrate potential of the welded IGBT is suspended. Compared with the constant DC voltage, the accumulation of space charge is also limited when the DC square wave is applied. The space charge behavior affects the local electric field of IGBT package insulation, which should be further studied in the future.

articleTitle: Aging Performance of DC-Link Capacitors Under Alternating Humid and Thermal Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Metallized film capacitors are now widely used in DC-Link capacitors. Voltage, temperature and humidity are the three main factors affecting capacitor aging. This paper mainly combines the common alternating humid and thermal environment in the practical application of DC-Link metallized film capacitors and the existing alternating humid and thermal standards, proposes to build an alternating humid and thermal aging platform for the alternating humid and thermal aging conditions of DC-Link capacitors, conducts alternating humid and thermal aging of two groups of capacitors, and studies the alternating humid and thermal aging characteristics of the two groups of capacitors. The results show that Group 2 capacitors have better resistance to alternating humid and thermal aging, and the Group 1 capacitors is more susceptible to moisture intrusion.

articleTitle: An energy router with current-limiting function structure
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The core component of the energy router is dual active bridge (DAB) DC transformer, for its short circuit fault current rise rate is fast, the peak value is large, resulting in the DAB internal power electronic device blocking problem, this paper proposes a current-limiting type structure of the energy router with current-limiting type structure, the structure of current-limiting device from the high-voltage side of the H-bridge of the DAB connected to a single-phase rectifier bridge, and then connected with the current-limiting inductor at the output port. When a short-circuit fault occurs on the output DC side, the current-limiting energy router uses a model predictive control strategy to rectify the current, provide clamping voltage for the current-limiting inductor to limit the peak value of the fault current, and cooperate with the circuit breaker to realize the arc-free opening, which avoids blocking of the power electronic devices in the DAB, and quickly realizes the current limiting and isolation of the fault. The model of current-limiting energy router based on 10kV/750V DC transformer is constructed in the simulation system, and the simulation results show the effectiveness and feasibility of current-limiting energy router fault current limiting and isolation.

articleTitle: ICSGSC-Clean Energy Storage and Release System with Multiple Time Scales and Variable Capacity
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The proportion of new energy generation in the power grid is getting higher and higher, and the time and capacity of the supporting energy storage and release system also put forward higher requirements. By building a hybrid power storage system containing compressed air energy storage and energy release and hydrogen energy storage and release, and establishing the corresponding energy storage and release models, the electric motor-driven compressor is used to combine with electrolytic water to produce hydrogen in the energy storage stage, and the high temperature and high-pressure gas is generated in the expander after the combustion of hydrogen compressed air mixture in the energy release stage, and combined with hydrogen fuel cell power generation to achieve a variety of time scales and energy storage and release capacity Variable, the whole process of using clean energy to meet the needs of new energy consumption in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Power systems under extreme weather conditions of dust storms and sandstorms Research on resilience assessment methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Under the influence of low probability and high risk extreme weather, the power system will experience severe and large-scale power outages, and a highly resilient power system has the ability to withstand extreme disasters and restore normal operation as soon as possible. In order to evaluate the resilience of the power system under extreme weather conditions such as sandstorms and sandstorms, we first established a model for the impact of two disaster causing factors (sand currents and strong winds) on the power system. Based on system information, we used Monte Carlo sampling to select typical fault scenarios and proposed a new type of power system elasticity evaluation index. Finally, the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed evaluation method were verified using an IEEE15 node single machine system as an example.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effect of an Active Current Limiter on a DC Circuit Breaker’s Breaking Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The DC system always achieves fault isolation when dealing with issues by tripping the DC circuit breaker. However, the breaking stress requirements of the DC circuit breaker are significantly increased as a result of the poor damping properties of the DC system. This work studies the transient properties of active current limiting device in the breaking process of DC circuit breaker and offers a method of using active current limiting device and DC circuit breaker to collaborate with each other in order to solve this problem. The reliability of the DC circuit breaker breaking the DC system can be increased by reducing the voltage and current stresses placed on it during the breaking process by the active current limiting mechanism. The technique is then tested in the simulation environment of MATLAB/Simulink. The outcomes of the simulation demonstrate the beneficial influence of the active current limiting device on the DC circuit breaker’s breaking procedure.

articleTitle: Analysis of DC Microgrid Stability impedance method considering the State of Charge of Electric Vehicle Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the development of electric vehicles, they are increasingly valued. The large number of electric vehicles connected to the DC microgrid for charging and discharging will impact the DC microgrid’s stability. This article first establishes an equivalent impedance model for the DC bus voltage control unit and a load unit equivalent impedance model considering the SOC (State of Charge) of electric vehicle power batteries; Subsequently, the equivalent impedance of the DC microgrid system is calculated based on its structure. Finally, the stability of the DC microgrid system is determined by using the Bode diagram and Nyquist diagram of the system impedance stability judgment conditions. Through numerical examples, it was found that the DC microgrid gradually loses stability with the increase of SOC in electric vehicle power batteries.

articleTitle: Effect of working fluid on super-long gravity heat pipe geothermal power generation system
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Geothermal power generation is considered to have the potential as a basic power load, owing to its independence from ambient conditions, requiring no intermediate energy storage to cope with “peak clipping and valley filling”. The novel technical scheme of super-long gravity heat pipe (SLGHP) geothermal system in a single well has aroused widespread interest in the geothermal research and industry community. The advantage of this scheme is outputs saturated vapor, which can directly drive the turbine to produce electricity. For the SLGHP geothermal power system, the working fluid simultaneously affects the underground heat extraction process and the surface power generation system. In this study, a detailed analysis using the numerical and thermodynamic model is conducted based on the data from a real geothermal well in Xiong’an, Hebei Province of China. The appropriate production temperature was determined to maximize its power output. Thermodynamic analysis shows that under the same geothermal conditions, ammonia can produce higher power generation compared to water, although the exergy loss of water in ground power generation systems is relatively small. The difference narrows as geothermal conditions improve. This study unravels the generation performance of the two investigated working fluids, and the acquired knowledge can give the impetus required for further development of the SLGHP geothermal power generation system.

articleTitle: Short term load forecasting method for regional intelligent distribution network based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of smart grid construction, efficient and accurate short-term load forecasting for distribution networks is an essential requirement for the economic and reliable operation of power systems. To address the issues of insufficient consideration of factors and inadequate feature exploration in current load forecasting methods, a deep learning-based approach for short-term load forecasting in regional intelligent distribution networks is proposed. Firstly, the maximum information coefficient (MIC) is used to select features that affect load data. Then, Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) model is utilized to explore the internal patterns and variations within the data, with the addition of an attention mechanism to highlight important information. Additionally, the dung beetle optimization algorithm (DBO) is employed to optimize the hyperparameters of the hybrid network model. Finally, a case study is conducted using real data from a distribution network in Shanxi province. The results show that compared to other methods such as LSTM, GRU, GRU-Attention, and SSA-BiGRU-Attention, the proposed method achieves higher forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Adaptive Algorithm Controls Oxygen Excess Coefficient of Air Blower and System Net Power of Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) is a complex system that involves multiple inputs and outputs and has multiple interrelated variables. The output power is mainly affected by gas temperature, gas pressure in the pile and oxygen excess coefficient (OEC) in the gas supply system, resulting in output power fluctuation, voltage instability and long response time. By combining the mechanism model and the empirical model, the model of the fuel cell air supply system is constructed in the simulation. Analyzing the effects of gas temperature, anode and cathode pressure difference and oxygen excess coefficient on the static and dynamic curves of the reactor to the output voltage through the simulation. Designing Fuzzy adaptive PID (Proportion Integral Derivative) simulation is designed to realize the stability of oxygen excess coefficient of air blower and system net power. Compared with neural network strategy, fuzzy control strategy does not need training data and requires less data for simple structure. Compared with traditional PID, fuzzy control has short response time and strong robustness. Through MATLAB/Simulink simulation, the effectiveness of the model and the performance of the method such as small oscillation, fast response and fast convergence are verified.

articleTitle: Design of High-performance Hybrid Supercapacitors Based on MOF Derived Cobalt Sulfide
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: As an energy storage device with high power density, fast charging, discharging capability, and long cycle life, the low energy density of supercapacitors still limits their application scenarios. Herein, to overcome this defect, cobalt sulfide derived from MOF is reported to assembly hybrid supercapacitors. First, MOF-based precursors (ZIF-67@GO) were prepared. Then, the above precursor was converted into CoS@rGO ultrathin nanoparticle electrode materials by the solvent-thermal process. Finally, the aqueous hybrid supercapacitor was assembled by reasonably matching the positive and negative electrodes. The hybrid energy storage device has an operating voltage range of 1.6 V and an energy density of 14.2 Wh $kg^{-1}$ at a power density of 400 W $kg^{-1}$ and an energy density of up to 6.64 Wh $kg^{-1}$ when the power density is increased to 3,923 W $kg^{-1}$. The preparation method of CoS nanoparticle electrode materials proposed in this paper is expected to provide a theory for applying MOF materials in the new energy field by providing a specific theoretical basis and reference.

articleTitle: Study on Hybrid Control Strategy of DC Microgrid Bus Voltage Considering Additional Inertia Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In DC microgrids, the problem of conflicting bus voltage offset and distribution accuracy exists. Therefore, this paper proposes a hybrid control strategy for DC microgrid bus voltage considering additional inertia adjustment. The control strategy combines the step-down control and the additional control, where the step-down control is used to realize the DC bus voltage unification, and the additional control provides inertia to the microgrid to improve the dynamic response capability. Finally, the proposed strategy is validated by MATLAB/Simulink simulation. The results show that the novel control is able to improve the current distribution accuracy degree while ensuring the bus voltage fluctuation, and at the same time effectively improve the stability of the DC microgrid in a wider impedance range.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling of agricultural park integrated energy system considering adjustable load
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In this paper, in view of the problems of high energy cost and low rate of renewable energy consumption in the integrated energy system of agricultural parks, and considering that part of the load in the integrated energy system of agricultural parks has a certain degree of adjustability, a method of optimal scheduling of the integrated energy system of agricultural parks considering adjustable loads is proposed. Firstly, the integrated energy system of the agricultural park is established by integrating electricity-gas-cooling-heat energy sources in view of the diversified characteristics of energy sources in the agricultural park; then, based on the adjustable characteristics of the load in the agricultural park, an optimal scheduling model of the integrated energy system of the agricultural park with adjustable load is established by taking the minimisation of the total operating cost of the system as the objective function; finally, the particle swarm algorithm is used for solving the algorithms. The results show that the optimal scheduling of the integrated energy system in the agricultural park considering the adjustable load can reduce the integrated operating cost of the park, and the operating cost of the system is reduced by 37.9% and the new energy consumption rate is increased by 19.27% in a typical day of summer; in a typical day of winter, the operating cost of the system is reduced by 37.42% and the new energy consumption rate is increased by 24.25%, which verifies the proposed model and algorithm’s effectiveness. model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Power prediction of photovoltaic power generation based on LSTM model with additive Attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation is affected by meteorological factors, characterized by intermittency, readiness and fluctuation, which brings challenges to the stable operation of PV power generation systems. Therefore, accurate prediction of PV power generation is of great significance. In this study, the LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory Network) model based on additive attention mechanism aims to improve the prediction accuracy of PV power. Firstly, the Pearson correlation coefficient method is used to pre-screen the meteorological data and select the meteorological parameters with higher correlation with PV power. Then Principal Component Analysis was applied to reduce the data dimensionality, and the most relevant parameters affecting PV power were successfully mined as inputs to the prediction model. Next, the additive Attention mechanism is introduced into the LSTM model, which is conducive to reducing the influence of irrelevant variables and paying more attention to useful input parameters. It is verified experimentally that the Attention-LSTM-based prediction model has higher accuracy in different weather scenarios when compared with single LSTM model, BP (BackPropagation Neural Network) model, and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model. Therefore, the model proposed in this study can effectively improve the prediction of PV power.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Warning Method for Internal Overheating Defects of GIS Isolating Switches on the Basis of Multi-point Temperature Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Due to its fully enclosed form and complex internal heat transfer processes, it is difficult to monitor the temperature field in the event of internal abnormalities in GIS equipment, which makes it challenging to quickly diagnose and warn internal defects. This issue seriously affects the safe operation of equipment. This paper focuses on the problem of overheating defects in GIS equipment and designs a multi-point temperature monitoring scheme for the shell, conducting related simulation experiments. By monitoring external temperature key points, the experiment acquires time series data for multiple temperature points. Combined with the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model, it fully explores the time correlation between heat points and multiple temperature points. By training with multiple time steps, it obtains a prediction method for the temperature of the internal heat point in GIS equipment and judges the severity level of the temperature data obtained. Through experimental data analysis, this method can more accurately, conveniently and stably diagnose overheating defects in GIS equipment compared to traditional heat monitoring techniques. The method is applicable to different overheating defect application scenarios and can effectively improve the overheating detection capability of power equipment, ensuring the safe operation of GIS equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Data-driven Remaining Useful Life Prediction Method for Lithium-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing methods for predicting the remaining useful life of lithium batteries are difficult to reflect the inconsistency of the batteries and have poor prediction stability. A battery life prediction method based on modified particle swarm optimization-least squares support vector machine (MPSO-LSSVM) with multiple health factors is proposed. Firstly, using NASA and TOYOTA datasets, available capacity and internal resistance are selected as the health factors; available energy is adopted as the life evaluation index. The mapping prediction model is established by LSSVM, and the regularization parameters and kernel function parameters are optimized by the MPSO algorithm. Finally, the long-short-term memory network (LSTM) and Gaussian process regression (GPR) models are validated. The results show that the average absolute error of the proposed MPSO-LSSVM lithium battery remaining useful life model is less than 0.0361, and the root mean square error is less than 0.0486; this proposed model shows better performance on prediction accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Capacity Planning of Park Integrated Energy System Considering Ladder-Type Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: To comprehensively address the low-carbon and economic aspects of the park integrated energy system (PIES) within the context of “dual carbon” initiative, this paper presents a multi-stage capacity planning approach for the PIES, which incorporates the step carbon trading mechanism. A carbon trading cost calculation model is developed considering the stepped carbon trading mechanism. Additionally, a multi-stage planning model is formulated for the PIES with the objective of minimizing the total costs, including investment, operation, maintenance and carbon trading expenses throughout the planning period. Further simulations are conducted to explore the reasons for the negative carbon trading cost observed in the PIES, as well as to examine the sensitivity of the multi-stage planning model to the carbon trading benchmark price and the length of the carbon trading price interval.

articleTitle: Research on Analysis Method of Demand Response Potential of Typical Users in Low Carbon Park
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Demand response changes users’ way of using electricity, which can effectively alleviate the pressure on power grid operation and increase the consumption of new energy power generation. As a basic unit participating in demand response, there are many types of users in the industrial park and the characteristics of users are very different. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze the response potential of various users, and then obtain the aggregated amount of the industrial park. First, sort out the energy consumption mode of various users in the industrial park; Secondly, based on users’ energy consumption characteristics and historical power consumption data, the typical daily load curves of users are obtained; Thirdly, taking the minimization of carbon emissions and electricity cost as the optimization goal, considering the response load constraints, economy, and specific types of electrical equipment, construct a demand response potential evaluation model. Solve the multi-objective problem with the linear weighting method; Finally, three typical users are selected for numerical analysis to verify the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Multi-stage Reserve Procurement Method for Power System with High Penetration Renewables Considering Nonanticipativity Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Reasonable deployment of thermal power unit reserve capacity is the key to dealing with the randomness and volatility of renewable energy. At present, the two-stage reserve procurement method based on stochastic or robust approaches is difficult to effectively balance the economy and robustness of the power system. At the same time, it is difficult for the two-stage scheduling model to consider the nonanticipativity of decision-making, which may lead to the infeasibility of day-ahead reserve procurement results in intraday scheduling. Based on the widely used intraday scheduling strategy of model predictive control (MPC), this paper proposes a multi-stage robust reserve procurement method that uses renewable energy scenarios to characterize uncertainty while considering nonanticipativity constraints. The method can obtain the robustness of the reserve procurement results satisfying the probability condition. At the same time, the method innovatively proposes and uses a constraint set construction method that can correct the nonanticipativity of the reserve procurement decision. The calculation results show that, compared with the two-stage scheduling method based on stochastic and robust approaches, the reserve procurement method proposed in this paper has significant advantages in taking into account the economics and robustness of the power system as well as guaranteeing the nonanticipativity.

articleTitle: EdgeGNN-Transformer: Extract the Change Edge Signal in Power Grid Management
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Under the background of low carbon emissions, automatic power dispatching has emerged as a crucial field of study. The Learning to Run a Power Network Challenge (L2RPN) models this problem as a reinforcement learning task. The entire pipeline can be divided into two stages: the first stage is the feature extractor, which uses GNN or transformer to extract timing signals such as power generation and loads in the power grid environment, and operating signals of power plants to obtain abstract advanced features (F). The second stage is a policy generator, which learns the optimal dispatching strategy action based on the F features generated in the first stage and reward-punishment functions, ensuring the smooth operation of the power grid. However, In the first stage, they only focus on the feature changes on the nodes in the power grid, ignoring the changes between the connections of the power grid nodes. To address this issue, Our algorithm proposes a new type of feature extractor, the EdgeGNN-Transformer, which can effectively extract the change signal on the grid topology and represent the real situation of the power grid, thereby improving the dispatching strategy’s effectiveness. Experiments prove that our algorithm outperforms SMAAC (ICLR2021) [1] on three datasets, IEEE-5, IEEE-14, and L2RPN WCCI2020. Our code will be open-sourced after the paper has been accepted.

articleTitle: A comprehensive energy service evaluation method based on AHP-entropy weight method and comprehensive fuzzy evaluation method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In response to the problem that modern comprehensive energy services have many influencing factors and are difficult to analyze quantitatively, a comprehensive energy service evaluation method based on AHP-entropy power method and comprehensive fuzzy evaluation method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the existing power supply service system is sorted out and a new power supply service system is constructed; secondly, a comprehensive energy evaluation index system is constructed from three dimensions: evaluation of integrated energy value-added service products, evaluation of integrated energy service providers and potential of product promotion business opportunities; then, the combination weights of each index are determined by using hierarchical analysis and entropy weight method, and the final evaluation results are calculated by combining with comprehensive fuzzy evaluation method; Finally, the feasibility of the method of this paper was verified by analyzing the case of a multi-energy complementary new energy project built in a park in a province of southwest China.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effect of electrical vehicles charging load on utility grid based on the residential behaviour characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are regarded as a particular energy storage device in the electric grid and one of the green urban transportation approaches powered by electric energy to reduce urban carbon emissions. It has a strong impact on the charging behavior of urban electric load and electric load systems. Therefore, an urgent need is to analyze the characteristics of current urban electric vehicle charging behavior and its overall impact on urban power operations. In this paper, the K-means clustering algorithm and GIS system are utilized to analyze urban electric vehicle users’ spatial and temporal characteristics of charging behavior. The paper exemplifies a province in China during the period from March 2022 to May 2023. The results show that the charging behaviors present an obvious spatiotemporal heterogeneity. The characteristics show different charging load peaks ranging from 1 to 3 throughout the day. This paper further compares the characteristics of residential EV charging behavior, the provincial electricity load and provincial renewable energy generation power. It provides a reference for the government to meet the peaks and summers of the electric power system, to reduce the rate of renewable energy wind and solar energy abandonment, and to reduce the peaks and valleys of electric power.

articleTitle: Review of the Application of Deep Reinforcement Learning in Multi-Component Coordinated Control of Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Microgrid plays an important role in distributed new energy consumption, load optimization, and improving energy efficiency. However, the intermittency of new energy output and the randomness of load-side power consumption behavior make the microgrid a dynamic complex system, and it is difficult to establish its accurate mathematical model, which brings great challenges to the optimal operation of the microgrid. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) finds the optimal strategy through trial and error interaction with the environment, does not rely on accurate modeling of micro source output and load, is suitable for solving sequential decision-making problems, and has advantages in solving microgrid optimization operation problems with a large number of uncertainty units. Therefore, this paper reviews and analyzes the modeling and optimization of microgrids, the principle of DRL, the application of DRL in microgrids, and the application of DRL in the coordinated operation of multiple components, and finally prospects the algorithm interpretability, reward function setting, and user privacy faced in the applications.

articleTitle: Review of Research on optimal scheduling method of virtual power plant
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the introduction of the dual carbon target, the utilization of renewable energy and the intensity of carbon emission reduction have been increased. The proportion of renewable energy in the power system has also brought challenges to energy management and scheduling. Virtual power plant (VPP) is a flexible and efficient energy management method, which is helpful to realize the efficient utilization and optimal scheduling of renewable energy. This paper summarizes the research status of VPP architecture, VPP optimization algorithm and VPP optimization scheduling key technology. Firstly, the typical architecture of technical VPP is summarized. Secondly, the common VPP optimal scheduling model is introduced, the necessity of optimization algorithm is studied, and several optimization algorithms are reviewed. Then, the key technologies of VPP optimal scheduling are introduced. Finally, the current shortcomings of VPP optimal scheduling are summarized and the future development direction is prospected.

articleTitle: Allocation Method of Daily Carbon Emission Quota and Dispatch Strategies in Parks Considering Typical Operating Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: This paper proposes an allocation method of daily carbon emission quota and the dispatch strategy in industrial parks considering typical operational scenarios. Firstly, data preprocessing is performed on the original electrical load of each feeder flowing into the park, and daily operation characteristics of each feeder are generated. Then, the K-means method is used to cluster the daily operational characteristics, where the Elbow Method is applied to determine the optimal number of clusters, thereby obtaining the typical daily operational scenarios for each feeder. Furthermore, the daily carbon emission quota for different operating scenarios of each feeder in the next year is allocated according to its proportion in the annual carbon emission. Finally, a dispatch optimization model of the park, considering demand response with the aid of flexible loads, is established, where the comfort level and the change rate of operating cost are introduced as objectives. This study provides a new method for carbon emission quota allocation in daily scheduling of park, and offers a powerful tool for the achievement of dual carbon goals in park.

articleTitle: Wind Power Forecasting Based on Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The rapid increase in wind power consumption presents new challenges for power system operation. Accurate forecasting of wind power is recognized as a major contribution for promoting its consumption and improving the stability of grid operation. This study focuses on forecasting wind power for an onshore wind farm in the United States by incorporating spatiotemporal relationships among 200 wind turbines. We proposed a novel encoder-decoder structure model. In the encoder module, a graph neural network structure is used to capture the intricate geographical distance features and sequence similarity features of the wind turbines as spatial features. The extracted spatial features are then integrated with temporal features into the model by serving as inputs to the gated recurrent unit (GRU) module. In the decoder module, the last state of the top layer of the encoder serves as the initial hidden parameters of the GRU blocks. Finally, the predicted wind powers are given by the decoder. Our model exhibits superior accuracy and enhanced generalization capabilities.

articleTitle: The Impact of Photovoltaic Power Stations on the Ecological Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The global non-renewable energy situation is grim, and the new energy photovoltaic power generation technology is becoming increasingly mature and widely used. With the rapid development of the photovoltaic industry, the large-scale layout of photovoltaic modules has different degrees of impact on the ecological environment. The terrestrial photovoltaic array covers a large area of the surface, which significantly changes to the surface energy balance and precipitation, thus affecting the soil changes and plant growth status, and has an impact on the local ecological environment. The construction of water surface photovoltaic power station is of great significance to water environment management. In this paper, the main content is the impact of photovoltaic power station on water environment, soil, vegetation, microclimate, animals and microorganisms.

articleTitle: Robust Optimal Charging Scheduling for Electric Vehicles Considering the Uncertainty of Renewable Energy Output
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The rapid development of new energy has a significant impact on the economy and stability of distribution network operations due to its randomness and volatility. A robust economic dispatch model for the distribution system was constructed, using the charging and discharging power of the cluster EV as the control variable, which effectively addressed the adverse effects of new energy integration into the distribution network. Firstly, the active output model of new energy (wind power and photovoltaic) was built, which described the uncertainty of new energy output in the form of a box uncertainty set. Then, based on the operation of the distribution network, a robust economic optimization scheduling model for electric vehicles considering the uncertainty of new energy output was established. The particle swarm optimization algorithm was used to solve the inner layer max-min subproblem, and the Benders decomposition method was used to iteratively solve the main problem and subproblem. A distribution system scheduling scheme with high robustness to the uncertainty of new energy output fluctuations was obtained. Finally, case analysis shows that the scheduling scheme of the proposed Robust optimization model can effectively address the impact of uncertainty in new energy output.

articleTitle: Distributed PV Power Forecasting Considering Spatio-temporal Dependence
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the increase of installed capacity and proportion of distributed photovoltaic (PV), the influence of its random and fluctuation characteristics on the dispatching management of power grid and station cannot be ignored. However, at present, distributed PV does not require the configuration of proprietary power forecasting system, and the irradiance data that are often used to realize PV decoupling and forecasting cannot be directly obtained because the measuring devices are rarely installed in small and medium-sized PV stations. Therefore, this paper proposes a method to estimate the regional irradiance by using the actual power data of some known PV systems, and deeply mines the spatio-temporal correlation information of the irradiance/power data of the distributed PV cluster to improve the power forecasting accuracy. Simulation results show that the method is more accurate than the satellite-based method in irradiance retrieval. In the aspect of PV power forecasting, the performance of the conventional forecasting method based only on time correlation is not as good as that of the method proposed in this paper, and the distributed PV power can be tracked and predicted better after considering the spatiotemporal dependence of resources.

articleTitle: Graph Based Quantitative Analysis of Distributed Generation Impact on Regional Carbon Emissions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Accurately accounting for carbon emissions is a fundamental requirement for understanding the trends in carbon emissions in the power system, effectively implementing carbon reduction measures, and promoting the green transformation of the economy. This paper proposed a method for the locally balanced calculation of carbon intensity at regional power grid nodes, based on the concept of regional carbon flow balance, considering distributed generation in the computation, and following the principle of regional generation prioritizing local consumption. The paper defined the net generation, load, and intermediate nodes in the regional power grid. Using graph databases and graph computing, the method achieved local aggregation and local prioritization to calculate the carbon intensity of end nodes (net generation and net load nodes) and intermediate nodes. The proposed method was validated using actual data from a provincial power grid and compared with the results obtained from existing methods, allowing for analysis of the reasons for changes in regional carbon intensity.

articleTitle: A Review of Wind Farm Wake Characteristics under Complex Terrain Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the gradual deterioration of the global environment and climate and the gradual depletion of fossil fuels, it is particularly important to transform the energy utilization system from fossil energy to sustainable renewable energy. As one of the most promising renewable energy sources, wind energy utilization is expected to grow substantially in the next few decades and play a key role in mitigating climate change and achieving energy sustainability. The study of wake characteristics of wind farms plays an important role in maximizing wind energy utilization efficiency and optimizing wind farm layout. Nowadays, more and more wind farms are located on complex terrain, so the research on the influence of complex terrain on the power generation efficiency of wind farms is particularly important. This paper briefly introduces the research status of wake characteristics of wind farms under complex terrain, which provides a theoretical basis for the subsequent research on wake characteristics of wind farms under complex terrain.

articleTitle: Review of Stability Analysis of High-Speed Rail Traction Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In recent years, China’s high-speed railroads are developing rapidly, and more and more power electronics devices are connected to the traction network. The Low-Frequency Oscillation (LFO) phenomenon of electrified railroads occurs frequently, which seriously affects the safe and stable operation of railroads and traffic scheduling, and causes more and more concerns. This paper takes the stability of the traction power supply system of the high-speed railway as the research object and compares the research results in this field for more than ten years, firstly, it describes the common impedance modeling methods and stability analysis criteria of the traction power supply system of high-speed railway and summarizes the factors affecting the stability of the vehicle network system and the causes of low-frequency oscillation. Finally, the methods for suppressing low-frequency oscillations are reviewed from both the network side and the vehicle side to help further suppress the phenomenon of low-frequency oscillations in high-speed rail in the future.

Author Keywords: High-speed railroad traction power supply system

articleTitle: Analysis Model of Cascading Faults in AC-DC Hybrid Transmission System with Multiple Types of DC Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: This paper establishes a cascading failure analysis model for AC-DC hybrid transmission system with multiple types of DCs based on improved OPA model. This model incorporates LCC-HVDC and MMC-HVDC, and models the control methods for both types of DC lines. By utilizing DC power flow calculation method that considers voltage magnitude and reactive power flow, it can calculate the transmission power of the DC system under various operational conditions, premised on system voltage status and power flow level. This model excels in simulating cascading failure processes that involve operations such as DC control mode switching, DC dispatch responses, voltage control, and reactive power and voltage protection actions at a significantly faster pace compared to transient models.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Optimal Scheduling of Flexibly Interconnected Low-voltage Distribution Transformer Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: This paper first introduces the background of the flexible interconnection system of low-voltage distribution areas containing photovoltaic, energy storage systems, and charging piles, and reviews the existing studies on the optimal scheduling models of flexible interconnection systems. On this basis, this paper proposes the evaluation indices of the day-ahead scheduling and the optimization model to obtain the optimal scheduling strategies. The optimization model includes operating constraints of components such as distribution transformers, photovoltaic, energy storage systems, and charging piles, and operating constraints of systems such as nodal and branch power flow, and the objective functions. Subsequently, the optimization model is linearized to be a MILP model and can be solved by off-the-shelf solvers such as Cplex and Gurobi. Finally, a case study on a flexible interconnection system with two distribution areas in a park is designed and solved, and the effectiveness of the proposed optimization model is verified.

articleTitle: Design of Net Zero Energy Building Photovoltaic Power Generation and Energy Storage System in Lanzhou
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: This article takes the China Construction Building in Lanzhou New District as the research object. Firstly, combined with the meteorological conditions of Lanzhou City, the energy consumption of the China Construction Building was analyzed using OpenStudio software. Based on the energy consumption data, a set of photovoltaic-energy storage system completely powered by renewable energy was designed according to the actual conditions of the China Construction Building, and the capacity configuration was carried out. The PVsyst software was used to simulate and verify the feasibility and reliability of the designed system. Finally, the economic analysis of the photovoltaic-energy storage system was conducted, and the environmental benefits of the system were analyzed.

articleTitle: Negative Sequence Current Compensation And Energy Management Optimization Of Traction Network Based On Series Energy Storage Railway Power Regulation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The load characteristics of high-speed railway systems have an adverse effect on the three-phase symmetry of the power supply system. A back-to-back converter connected in series to a supercapacitor energy storage device is used to solve the three-phase imbalance problem and the regenerative braking energy recovery problem of trains that occurs during the operation of the railway system. An improved particle swarm algorithm is used to optimise the access capacity of the back-to-back converter. The mechanism of negative sequence complete compensation of the energy storage type railway power conditioner when the grid voltage is unbalanced is analysed, the compensation coefficient of the energy storage system, the active and reactive current compensation coefficients are introduced, the degree of negative sequence compensation and the compensation capacity of the traction substation and the load balance of the supply arm are taken as the optimisation objectives, and the optimised compensation model of the energy storage type railway power conditioner is proposed. Simulation analysis of the newly accessed circuit structure model shows that the model can make full use of the regenerative braking energy of electric locomotives, compensate the negative sequence current introduced into the three-phase grid by the traction system and reduce the energy demand of the traction transformer by the traction load.

articleTitle: Design of Situation Awareness Terminal for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of new energy and sensitive loads into the grid, traditional distribution network monitoring equipment can no longer meet the requirements of the new type of power system. To accurately and timely grasp the operational characteristics of the distribution network, this paper proposes a situation awareness terminal for the distribution network based on the application scenario of the distribution network. Firstly, an adaptive switching measurement algorithm is proposed to improve the measurement accuracy and dynamic response speed of the terminal. Then, a terminal hardware design scheme combining terminal reliability improvement technology is proposed. Finally, the algorithm performance of the distribution network’s situation awareness terminal is verified.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Prediction of PV Ramp Events Based on LSTM-Bootstrap
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: In recent years, renewable energy has received widespread attention. However, due to the impact of climate change, the output power of photovoltaic (PV) power generation is highly variable, which poses a challenge to grid scheduling. The PV power ram event, i.e. the drastic change of PV power in a short period of time, has a particularly obvious impact on the power grid. This paper first summarises the current state of PV ramp-up research. Then, three common definitions of PV ramp-up events and the definition chosen in this study are described in detail. Then, a new ramp prediction method is proposed: first, the mRMR feature selection method is used to screen the input features; then, the LSTM network is constructed to predict the PV power; finally, the prediction intervals with different confidence levels are given in combination with the bootstrap method, and the probability of the ramp is determined accordingly. The effectiveness of the method is verified by simulation. This study provides new ideas for further improving the accuracy of PV ramp prediction. The experimental results show that by selecting the appropriate ramp threshold and determining the ramp probability, this method has achieved better results in terms of accuracy, hit rate, critical success index and other evaluation indicators.

articleTitle: Analysis of main influencing factors on braking energy of metro trains in high latitude and perennial low temperature area
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Due to significant differences in climate, residents’ living habits, and economy between high latitude and perennial low temperature area in China and other regions, the actual operating environment and situation of metro trains in this region are also different from those in other regions. Different operation and operating environments will have different impacts on the braking energy of metro trains. In order to explore the factors affecting the braking energy of metro trains in high latitude and perennial low temperature area of China, taking Harbin Metro Line 1 as an example, based on the actual operating parameters of metro trains, the calculation and analysis of loss of train running resistance, loss of train mechanical braking, train regenerative braking feedback, and wheel rail adhesion coefficient were carried out. Obtaining the relationship between the lateral force of the wheel axle and the lateral acceleration of the frame as a function of speed in the special operating environment of metro trains in high latitude and perennial low temperature area; the relationship between the load and running resistance of a train at the same running speed; the relationship between the variation of train speed and braking distance under the same load conditions, as well as the impact on air braking; the relationship between the load of a train and the average braking deceleration at the same initial braking speed, as well as the impact on resistance braking; the variation trend of the load of a train and operating speed with wheel rail adhesion coefficient. This provides data reference and valuable experience for studying the factors affecting the braking energy of metro trains in high latitude and perennial low temperature area.

Author Keywords: high latitude and perennial low temperature area

articleTitle: Feature Fusion Based on Locally Linear Embedding in Fault Diagnosis of A Single-Phase PWM Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: To advance the traction drive system reliability and the stability of overhead contact system, reduce the railway traffic accidents, ensure the safe operation of electric locomotives. For the single-phase Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) rectifier with high failure rate in electric locomotive traction drive system, a fault diagnosis method based on Locally Linear Embedding (LLE) algorithm in manifold learning theory is proposed for fusion of high dimensional features. The wavelet packet energy feature is extracted from the fault signal by wavelet packet transform, and as the high-dimensional feature (HDF). And then the low-dimensional feature which can be used to describe the diagnosis feature is obtained by using the LLE algorithm in the manifold learning algorithm to eliminate redundant information in HDF. In the simulation, it is verified that the final diagnosis result for the method is 95.33% when the load direct current (DC) voltage changes from 2000V to 2800V. The results show that this method has the advantages of good robustness, high fault diagnosis precision, simple implementation and no need for complicated parameter calculation.

articleTitle: Carbon emission effect of new power system with new energy as the main component in Gansu Province, China
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: Building a new type of power system will help promote clean energy consumption and help the world respond to the serious threats and challenges posed by climate change. Based on the social economy, energy consumption and development planning of Gansu Province, this study analyzed the main influencing factors of energy consumption and carbon emissions in Gansu Province, set development scenarios of different energy consumption structures, and predicted the future development of energy consumption and carbon emissions. The optimization of terminal energy structure is an important measure for future energy transformation and the realization of “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals” in Gansu Province. By promoting new energy generation such as power stroke and light energy in the future, energy substitution can be effectively realized, the cleanliness level of the whole society can be improved, and significant benefits can be provided for pollution reduction and carbon reduction in Gansu Province.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Sustainable Parking Lot
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: This paper aims to eliminate the loophole that unregistered vehicles abuse to avoid fines and park illegally by devolving an IoT-based smart parking access control system. The proposed system utilizes a single-board computer with a set of sensors, cameras and actuators. The access control system employs a combination of vehicle detection and plate recognition algorithms to identify and authenticate vehicles entering and exiting the parking lot. Moreover, a carbon emissions sensor at the gate is used to detect the generated emission rates by vehicles entering the parking lot. Furthermore, deep learning neural network was used to predict the congestion of the parking lot at any day or time. Moreover, a website was developed to enable administrators and users to access and interact with the system. Experimental results showed that the system was able to perform the functionality with high accuracy. The coefficient of determination ($\mathbf{R}^{\mathbf{2}}$) achieved of the car congestion prediction module was 0.97. A survey was conducted to measure the users’ satisfaction with the proposed system. The survey results indicated that the majority of respondents (90.6%) reported an overall positive attitude towards the user interface and expressed their satisfaction with the system. The benefits of this work include the well-being and convenience of the paying participants in addition to tremendously reducing the workload required of the parking security guards and creating a more environmentally friendly parking lot. The proposed system can be utilized in public parking, residential towers and compounds, and shopping malls.

articleTitle: Multiobjective Decisions on Microgrid Interconnection Location Based on Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Smart Grid and Smart Cities (ICSGSC)
abstract: The interconnected location of the microgrid is related to the stable operation of both the distribution network and microgrid. This paper used the sitting of microgrid as a foothold to reduce the impact of voltage deviation and network loss after microgrid connection to the distribution; a method on the interconnected location of the microgrid based on multiobjective decision is proposed. This method synthetically considers the voltage deviation, network loss, voltage improvement level, network loss improvement level and static voltage stability index after the microgrid is connected to the distribution network. First, the microgrid is respectively connected to each candidate node in the distribution network system, and the five selected indexes of each node are calculated according to the power flow. Then, by constructing the ideal optimal object and the ideal worst object, the candidate nodes are divided into three categories by means of fuzzy clustering. The Euclidean distance method is then used to further refine the clustering results to realize the sorting of the candidate nodes. Finally, the accuracy and rationality of the sorting results are verified by the simulation results of a typical microgrid connected to an IEEE14 distribution network.
